category_title: Students with Intellectual Disability (ID) receiving individual support
scenario_title: Group instruction in core subjects without individual support
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a mainstream classroom during a whole-group math lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, we are going to work on the math worksheet together. Please look at the first problem on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the desk, showing no interaction behaviour with the teacher or peers.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think the answer is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains silent and does not participate in the group activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to follow along with the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet away and turns around in the chair, becoming completely inattentive and misbehaving during the group instruction.)
